title: Consolidating Rewarded Perturbations for LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.31494v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Post-training of language models is commonly framed as a sample-score-update loop implemented by gradient descent. A recent line of work, exemplified by RandOpt, relocates this loop to weight space, sampling Gaussian perturbations around a pretrained model and ensembling the top-K rewarded specialists at inference. While competitive with PPO and GRPO under matched training compute, this prediction-level ensemble incurs K forward passes per test example and does not extend cleanly to free-form generation. We ask whether the rewarded population can instead be folded into a single deployable model, replacing the inference-time ensemble with one consolidated update. A split-half analysis over 25 model-task pairs reveals reproducible low-rank structure in every case. translated_title: 面向大语言模型后训练的奖励扰动整合
translated_abstract: 语言模型的后训练通常被构建为通过梯度下降实现的“采样-评分-更新”循环。最近的一系列工作（以RandOpt为代表）将这一循环迁移到权重空间：在预训练模型周围采样高斯扰动，并在推理时对得分最高的K个专家模型进行集成。尽管在匹配训练算力下，这种方法与PPO和GRPO相比具有竞争力，但这种预测层面的集成在每个测试样本上需要K次前向传播，且难以自然地扩展到自由文本生成任务。我们探究是否可以将经过奖励筛选的模型群体融合到一个可部署的单一模型中，用一次合并更新来取代推理时的集成。针对25个模型-任务组合的折半分析显示，所有情况下均存在可复现的低秩结构。我们将这种几何结构转化为CoRP（Consolidating Rewarded Perturbations，奖励扰动整合）——一种免梯度算子，它结合了奖励加权聚合、兼容性感知的重加权，以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CoRP，一种免梯度方法，利用奖励扰动群体中可复现的低秩结构，将推理时需要K次前向传播的top-K专家模型集成合并为单个可部署模型，从而降低推理开销并支持自由文本生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoRP, a gradient-free operator that exploits reproducible low-rank structure in rewarded perturbation populations to consolidate inference-time top-K specialist ensembles into a single deployable model, avoiding K forward passes per test example and extending to free-form generation.
